# Session 9: Settings, Search & Playlist Management

## Files to Change

- [`app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/MainActivity.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/MainActivity.kt) — read theme from DataStore and pass to `MusicPlayerTheme`
- [`app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/settings/SettingsScreen.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/settings/SettingsScreen.kt) — add About section
- [`app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/settings/SettingsViewModel.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/settings/SettingsViewModel.kt) — expose device audio capability properties
- [`app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/library/LibraryViewModel.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/library/LibraryViewModel.kt) — add 300 ms debounce, wire album/artist search
- [`app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/library/LibraryScreen.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/library/LibraryScreen.kt) — show album/artist search results when query is active
- [`app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/data/repository/MusicRepository.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/data/repository/MusicRepository.kt) — expose `searchAlbums` and `searchArtists`
- [`app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/playlist/PlaylistViewModel.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/playlist/PlaylistViewModel.kt) — create/rename/delete playlist, reorder tracks
- [`app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/playlist/PlaylistScreen.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/playlist/PlaylistScreen.kt) — drag handle reorder, swipe-to-remove
- [`app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/library/LibraryScreen.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/library/LibraryScreen.kt) — FAB on Playlists tab, create playlist dialog, add-to-playlist on track menus

---

## Part 1 — Settings

### 1a. Wire theme from DataStore → MainActivity

`MainActivity` currently hardcodes `AppTheme.AmoledBlack`. Fix:

```kotlin
// MainActivity.kt — collect theme preference before setContent
val themeFlow = dataStore.data.map { prefs ->
    when (prefs[stringPreferencesKey("theme")]) {
        "Light" -> AppTheme.Light
        "Dark" -> AppTheme.Dark
        else -> AppTheme.AmoledBlack
    }
}
val appTheme by themeFlow.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(AppTheme.AmoledBlack)
// pass appTheme into MusicPlayerTheme(appTheme = appTheme)
```

Inject `DataStore<Preferences>` into `MainActivity` via Hilt `@Inject`.

### 1b. About section in SettingsScreen

Add a new "About" card below existing settings sections. `SettingsViewModel` reads device audio properties on init:

```kotlin
val nativeOutputSampleRate: String = audioManager.getProperty(AudioManager.PROPERTY_OUTPUT_SAMPLE_RATE) ?: "Unknown"
val nativeOutputFrameCount: String = audioManager.getProperty(AudioManager.PROPERTY_OUTPUT_FRAMES_PER_BUFFER) ?: "Unknown"
val appVersion: String  // from BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME
```

UI rows: App Version, Native Sample Rate, Native Buffer Size (frames).

---

## Part 2 — Search

### 2a. Expose album/artist search in MusicRepository

`AlbumDao.searchAlbums` and `ArtistDao.searchArtists` already exist but are not wired up. Add two methods to `MusicRepository`:

```kotlin
fun searchAlbums(query: String): Flow<List<Album>>
fun searchArtists(query: String): Flow<List<Artist>>
```

### 2b. LibraryViewModel — debounce + all-type search

Replace the direct `setSearchQuery` call with a debounce using `StateFlow` + `debounce(300)`:

```kotlin
private val _searchQuery = MutableStateFlow("")
val searchQuery: StateFlow<String> = _searchQuery

// In init:
_searchQuery
    .debounce(300L)
    .distinctUntilChanged()
    .flatMapLatest { q ->
        if (q.isBlank()) emptyFlow()
        else combine(
            repo.searchTracks(q),
            repo.searchAlbums(q),
            repo.searchArtists(q)
        ) { t, al, ar -> SearchResults(t, al, ar) }
    }
    .stateIn(viewModelScope, ...)
```

Expose a `searchResults: StateFlow<SearchResults?>` (null when query is blank).

### 2c. LibraryScreen — show search results overlay

When `searchQuery` is non-blank, replace the normal tab pager with a single scrollable list containing three sections: **Tracks**, **Albums**, **Artists** (each with a header row and their respective item composables). Reuse existing `TrackListItem` and `AlbumCard`.

---

## Part 3 — Playlists

### 3a. Create playlist (FAB on Playlists tab)

- Add a `FloatingActionButton` in `LibraryScreen` only when the selected tab is "Playlists".
- Tapping shows an `AlertDialog` with a `TextField` for the name and Confirm/Cancel. On confirm, call `PlaylistViewModel.createPlaylist(name)`.

### 3b. Rename & delete

- Each playlist row in the Playlists tab gets a `…` IconButton with a `DropdownMenu` offering **Rename** and **Delete**.
- **Rename**: shows an `AlertDialog` pre-filled with the current name.
- **Delete**: shows a confirmation `AlertDialog`; on confirm calls `PlaylistViewModel.deletePlaylist(id)`.

### 3c. Add tracks to playlist (track picker sheet)

- Extend the existing track `…` menu in `TrackListItem` (or wherever track more-options menus live) with an **"Add to playlist"** option.
- Tapping opens a `ModalBottomSheet` listing all playlists. Tapping a playlist calls `PlaylistViewModel.addTrack(playlistId, trackId)`.
- Same picker is accessible from within `PlaylistScreen` via a separate "Add tracks" FAB/button.

### 3d. Drag-to-reorder in PlaylistScreen

Use [`androidx.compose.foundation` reorderable](https://github.com/aclassen/ComposeReorderable) or the Jetpack `LazyColumn` with `detectDragGestures`. Each row shows a drag handle icon (`Icons.Default.DragHandle`). On drag-end, call `PlaylistViewModel.reorderTracks(playlistId, fromIndex, toIndex)` which updates the `trackIds` list in Room.

### 3e. Swipe-to-remove in PlaylistScreen

Wrap each playlist track row in `SwipeToDismiss` (Material 3 `SwipeToDismissBox`). Swipe reveals a red "Remove" background; on dismiss, call `PlaylistViewModel.removeTrack(playlistId, trackId)`.

### 3f. PlaylistViewModel — fix trackIds parsing

Replace the fragile bracket-strip split with proper JSON parsing using `kotlinx.serialization` or `org.json.JSONArray` (already on classpath):

```kotlin
private fun parseIds(raw: String): List<Long> =
    JSONArray(raw).let { arr -> List(arr.length()) { arr.getLong(it) } }
```

---

## Dependencies to add

- `androidx.compose.material3:material3` already present — `SwipeToDismissBox` available in 1.2+.
- For drag-reorder: use `sh.calvin.reorderable:reorderable` (lightweight Compose-native library) **or** implement manually with `Modifier.pointerInput` + index swap. Prefer the library for correctness.

---

## Architecture diagram

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph settings [Settings]
        DS[DataStore] -->|theme pref| MA[MainActivity]
        MA -->|AppTheme| MusicPlayerTheme
        SettingsVM -->|AudioManager.getProperty| AboutSection
    end
    subgraph search [Search]
        LV[LibraryViewModel] -->|debounce 300ms| CombineFlow
        CombineFlow -->|SearchResults| LS[LibraryScreen]
        LS -->|query blank| NormalTabs
        LS -->|query active| SearchResultsList
    end
    subgraph playlists [Playlists]
        LibTab[LibraryScreen Playlists tab] -->|FAB| CreateDialog
        TrackMenu -->|Add to playlist| PickerSheet
        PickerSheet --> PVM[PlaylistViewModel]
        PVM --> PlaylistDao
        PS[PlaylistScreen] -->|SwipeToDismissBox| RemoveTrack
        PS -->|DragHandle| ReorderTracks
    end
```

## What was implemented

### Settings

**Theme wiring (`MainActivity.kt`)** — Injected `DataStore<Preferences>` into `MainActivity` and collect the `"theme"` key as a Compose state. The `AppTheme` is derived reactively, so switching themes in Settings now takes effect instantly without restarting the app.

**About section (`SettingsViewModel.kt`, `SettingsScreen.kt`)** — `SettingsViewModel` now injects `@ApplicationContext Context`, reads `AudioManager.PROPERTY_OUTPUT_SAMPLE_RATE` and `PROPERTY_OUTPUT_FRAMES_PER_BUFFER` at construction, and exposes `nativeSampleRate`, `nativeBufferSize`, and `appVersion` from `BuildConfig`. A new "About" section in `SettingsScreen` displays all three as read-only rows.

### Search

**Repository (`MusicRepository.kt`)** — Wired `albumDao.searchAlbums(query)` and `artistDao.searchArtists(query)` (which already existed in the DAOs but were unused).

**ViewModel (`LibraryViewModel.kt`)** — Added a `SearchResults` data class. The raw query updates immediately for the text field; a debounced+distinctUntilChanged flow drives a `flatMapLatest` that combines track, album, and artist search results into `searchResults: StateFlow<SearchResults?>` (null when blank). The main `uiState` combine now includes this as a 7th source.

**Screen (`LibraryScreen.kt`)** — When `searchQuery.isNotBlank()`, the tab row is hidden and a `SearchResultsView` renders three sections (Tracks / Albums / Artists) with a section count header. A spinner shows while the debounce is pending. Tapping any result navigates appropriately.

### Playlists

**Create** — A `FloatingActionButton` appears only on the Playlists tab. Tapping opens an `AlertDialog` with a name text field; Confirm calls `LibraryViewModel.createPlaylist`.

**Rename / Delete** — Each playlist row has a `⋮` `DropdownMenu` with Rename (opens a pre-filled dialog) and Delete (opens a confirmation dialog with a red "Delete" button).

**Add to playlist** — `TrackListItem` gained an optional `onAddToPlaylist: (() -> Unit)?` parameter. When provided, the `⋮` button opens a `DropdownMenu` containing "Add to playlist"; otherwise it calls `onMoreClick` directly (backward compatible). Tapping "Add to playlist" in `LibraryScreen` shows a `ModalBottomSheet` listing all playlists. `PlaylistScreen` has an "Add tracks" (`+`) action in the top bar that opens a sheet of tracks not yet in the playlist.

**Drag-to-reorder (`PlaylistScreen.kt`)** — Uses `sh.calvin.reorderable` (added to `libs.versions.toml` and `build.gradle.kts`). A `rememberReorderableLazyListState` drives the list; each row has a `DragHandle` icon with `Modifier.draggableHandle()`. A `LaunchedEffect` watches `isAnyItemDragging` and persists the new order via `PlaylistViewModel.reorderTracks` only when the drag ends.

**Swipe-to-remove** — Each playlist track is wrapped in `SwipeToDismissBox`. Swiping in either direction shows a red delete background and calls `viewModel.removeTrack`, removing it from both local UI state (instant) and Room (persisted).

**JSON fix (`PlaylistViewModel.kt`)** — All `trackIds` parsing now goes through `org.json.JSONArray` (on the Android SDK; no new dependency) in a shared `parseIds()` helper. All writes use `JSONArray(ids).toString()`. The fragile string-split approach is fully replaced.
